explanation:
# Clock tree report: uart, clock clk (50 MHz), CTS iteration 3

## Skew target and result
- Skew target: 2.0 ns (cts_tool.json target_ns).
- Worst tree skew over 9 corners: 0.039857 ns (max_ss_100C_1v60), about 2% of the target. Target met on every corner reported.
- The tool's "reported skew" (0.265540 to 0.289857 ns) includes a 0.25 ns clock uncertainty. Tree skew = reported skew minus 0.25 ns. Tree skew is the physical figure.

## Per-corner tree skew and source latency (setup view, ns)
| Corner | Tree skew | Source latency |
|---|---|---|
| max_ff_n40C_1v95 | 0.018103 | 0.422577 |
| nom_ff_n40C_1v95 | 0.016746 | 0.415424 |
| min_ff_n40C_1v95 | 0.015540 | 0.410445 |
| max_tt_025C_1v80 | 0.023809 | 0.620110 |
| nom_tt_025C_1v80 | 0.022172 | 0.611211 |
| min_tt_025C_1v80 | 0.020639 | 0.604673 |
| max_ss_100C_1v60 | 0.039857 | 1.110034 |
| nom_ss_100C_1v60 | 0.037169 | 1.097176 |
| min_ss_100C_1v60 | 0.034504 | 1.087248 |

Latency ranges from 0.410445 ns (min_ff) to 1.110034 ns (max_ss). Skew grows with latency, slowest at the ss corner. The spec (REQ-005) requires setup slack >= 0 at the typical corner at a 20 ns period.

## Clock buffers
- Clock buffers inserted: 39.
- Hold buffers inserted: 80. Timing repair buffers: 172. These are counts of added cells, reported as given by the tool.

## Effect on hold timing after CTS (worst slack, ns, nominal-process corners)
| Corner | Hold WS | Setup WS |
|---|---|---|
| nom_tt_025C_1v80 | 0.312645 | 10.1683 |
| nom_ss_100C_1v60 | 0.568475 | 3.720212 |
| nom_ff_n40C_1v95 | -0.002920 | 10.648337 |

- Setup is met with margin at all three corners reported (smallest: 3.720212 ns at ss).
- Hold is met at tt and ss, but nom_ff_n40C_1v95 shows a hold violation of -0.002920 ns (about 3 ps) after CTS and after 80 hold buffers. This is not a pass. I have not relaxed or waived anything.
- Hold and setup slack are given only for the three nom_* corners. Slack for the min_* and max_* corners is not in the data, so I make no claim about them.

## Conclusion
Skew and latency are well inside the 2.0 ns skew target. Hold timing is not clean: one fast corner is short by 0.002920 ns. This needs a hold-fix pass (Orion / Chronos) and a re-run of STA before sign-off. I make no claim that the real checks pass; the runtime runs them.
assumptions: Tree skew (reported skew minus 0.25 ns uncertainty) is taken as the physical skew; the tool gives both values.
Latency quoted is source_latency_ns from the setup view; no separate per-clock-pin latency was supplied.
Hold/setup slack was only supplied for the three nom_* corners, so nothing is claimed for min_* and max_* corners.
Only one clock (clk) exists per the spec, so tool metrics are attributed to clk.
open_issues: Hold violation -0.002920 ns at nom_ff_n40C_1v95 after CTS (80 hold buffers already inserted); needs hold repair and STA re-run, coordinate with Chronos and Orion.
Hold/setup slack for min_* and max_* corners not provided; request from Chronos.
172 timing repair buffers and 80 hold buffers are large for a small UART; Orion should review area impact.
